label: risky
summary: Release image drops its digest pin for node:latest and pipes a remote script into bash at build time.

findings.title: REL-002: Remote script piped to a shell during image build
findings.description: The Dockerfile downloads build-tools.sh over the network and pipes it straight into bash. Whoever controls that URL controls code that runs inside the release image build, and the script is not verified.
findings.recommendation: Vendor the script or download a pinned version and verify its checksum before running it.

evidence.observation: RUN curl ... | bash fetches and executes an unverified remote script.

uncertainty: Did not fetch the script to check what it does.

findings.title: REL-001: Base image changed from a digest pin to the latest tag
findings.description: FROM node:latest replaces a digest-pinned base image, so release builds are no longer reproducible and pick up whatever image the tag points to at build time.
findings.recommendation: Pin the base image to a specific version and digest, and update it through reviewed bumps.

evidence.observation: Base image now uses the mutable latest tag.
